ACC’s full list of its approved rescue groups

notes: Three times a week ACC lists cats and dogs who may be euthanised if nobody takes them; each listing closes about 42 hours later (Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday at 6 PM, closing at noon two days later). Open the animal's page. If it says "Sorry, this pet is for new hope partners only", only an approved rescue group can take it: press "Pre-Screener Form" and contact rescue groups yourself at once. If it has a "Reserve" button, a member of the public may adopt it directly: it goes into a cart for 15 minutes, and you check out at the top right and pay the deposit by card. The Pre-Screener Form needs a Google sign-in. Website trouble: adopt@nycacc.org. New Hope program questions: newhopeprogram@nycacc.org. The guide "Save a shelter animal from euthanasia" has every step and ready-made messages for rescue groups.

change_log.note: A reviewer pointed out that the record was written for rescues rather than for the public, and did not link to the application at all. The two links someone actually needs — which animals need placing now, and the form that says you have a home — are now first, and the pre-screener says up front that it wants a Google sign-in, because finding that out mid-deadline wastes the time that matters.
